summary: Re-tested the fixes from iteration_43 on the preview, using only e1test identities, with 0 LLM calls and no writes. 1) HIGH (preview wall): FIXED. viteGateWall.ts imports isPublicPath from server/publicPaths.ts, and server/vitePluginApi.ts is deleted. test_public_paths.py was updated: /admin* anonymous now expects /login?next=, and new cases cover /cookies, /unlock, /curriculum/one-page, /free-run/journal and /onboarding. A new parity test compares the preview against Express :8001 for 29 paths. Result: 69 passed, 1 xfailed (/unlock, explained below). 2) MEDIUM (authAwareFetch): FIXED. With the e1test-outsider session, /admin/activity stays signed in. admin.me returns 401 and events.people 403, /api/auth/me returns 200, there is no logout and no banner, and the cookie is kept (the page shows 'Owner access required'). A garbage app_session_id on /dashboard redirects to /login?next=%2Fdashboard&reason=session_expired and the 'Session expired' banner shows. 3) charge.refunded: the claim INSERT IGNORE is now in a try/catch that returns 500 (code review only). 4) /know Q1 progress bar is width 12.5% (1/8), PASS. 5) /login no longer says 'admin tools', PASS. 6) /brand switcher: PASS for real labels at 390 and 1920, with partial evidence (see issues). 7) /free-run at 390px: the theme pill no longer touches the Learn tab (pill bottom 760, tab top 765.6), PASS, but it now covers the chat input. 8) Pricing as e1test-owner: clicking purchase-pack-pour/glass calls the API, which returns 500 'Invalid API Key: sk_test_stub' as expected. A sonner error toast appears ('Checkout failed. Please try again...'), no native dialog fires, PASS.

minor.issue: /unlock is an Express route (unlockHandler: redeem guest pass, 302 to /curriculum?guest=1 or /?err=guest-pass-invalid). The preview Vite server serves the SPA for this path, so the Express handler never runs. Guest-pass redemption cannot be tested on the preview, but works in prod. The wall itself is consistent: the page is public on both. This is not a regression from this fix.

Code review: the claim is now wrapped (try/catch, 500), which is good. Remaining nits: (a) the dynamic imports of ../db.js and drizzle-orm sit before the try, low risk. (b) Two different refund events for the same charge can still race on the read-then-update of credit_refunds (carried over from iteration_43).
The raw Stripe error message and stack are still returned to the client in the tRPC 500 body (data.stack is visible on the preview). Check that NODE_ENV=production strips the stack.

ui_bugs.issue: The pill moved up (top 730, bottom 760) and now overlaps the lower-left of the fixed 'Ask a question...' chat input (about y 695-747). It no longer touches the Learn tab, but it covers part of the input and its placeholder.

issues: Real label 'E1 Test Crush Co' fits at both 390 and 1920. A simulated 38-character label ('E1 Test Owner Winery Estate · contract') still truncates at 390px (trigger 272px wide; scrollWidth 243 vs clientWidth 222) because the OWNER badge sits on the same row. Shorter names plus ' · contract' fit. The real contractor membership no longer exists (the contractor now sees only its own brand), so the actual ' · contract' label could not be rendered.
A faint blurred shadow or ghost element shows at top-centre (around x 800-1040, y 0-30) behind the header, possibly an empty floating banner or toast container. Worth a look.

action_items: Optional: move the /free-run theme pill above the chat composer at 390px, or hide it on /free-run, so it does not cover the Ask input
Optional: let the /brand switcher wrap below the OWNER badge on mobile (e.g. flex-wrap, or w-full on its own row) so long '<name> · contract' labels do not truncate
Optional: strip the Stripe error and stack from the tRPC error body for checkout
Note: /unlock guest-pass redemption cannot be tested on the preview (Vite serves the SPA); verify it in prod
critical_code_review_comments: viteGateWall.ts: single source of truth confirmed. A cookie that merely exists (any app_session_id value) bypasses the preview wall without JWT verification, unlike the gate cookie. The SPA then catches it via authAwareFetch on needsAuth paths. Gated pages outside needsAuth (e.g. /brand, /import) would render the shell for a garbage cookie. Low risk because data APIs are auth-checked, but this differs from prod if prod verifies the JWT.
main.tsx authAwareFetch: concurrent 401s each fire their own /api/auth/me probe. Harmless, but could be de-duplicated with a shared promise.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested fix checks (8/8); 1 new low-priority overlap
